rca_of_issue: Iteration 27 identified that KeepAwake.deactivateKeepAwake() returns a Promise on web; the surrounding sync try/catch could not swallow its async rejection, producing an uncaught 'The wake lock with tag ExpoKeepAwakeDefaultTag has not activated yet' red-screen after every clearTimer() (recap close, stop, give-up, unmount). Iteration 28 fix `try { KeepAwake.deactivateKeepAwake()?.catch?.(() => {}); } catch {}` chains .catch() onto the returned Promise (guarded by optional-chaining in case the return value is undefined on some platforms) AND keeps the outer sync try/catch as a belt-and-braces for platforms where the call throws synchronously. Verified: 0 wake-lock console errors and 0 pageerrors across the three real flows above.
